rows.sourceLocation: Current user task sections 3, 4A, 8, 9A/B/D/E and 10; controlling specification operator-next-action and semantic-review transition requirements
rows.observableExpectedBehavior: After a committed response changes the authoritative next operation or run, stale pre-acceptance UI lane selections cannot override that new state. Saving or exporting the next instruction uses the current derived operation and current applicable run; any explicitly created continuation becomes the new selection.
requiredEvidence: Run-5889 actual-browser reproduction
Permanent actual-control regression spanning a multi-operation stage
Fault injection that preserves a stale operation/run selection and is rejected
Affected prompt, acceptance, recovery, and browser verification on the exact repaired candidate

executedEvidence.actual: After Stage 02 COMPLETE acceptance, the saved next instruction did not bind SEARCH_ADEQUACY_REVIEW.

The verifier assigned JOB_ID text to #project-picker even though the production selector values are numeric project indices; the resulting empty selection coerced to projects[0]. Independent production semantic replay derived SEARCH_ADEQUACY_REVIEW, and verify-post-acceptance-lane-selection.mjs passed while detecting stale operation/run faults.

executedEvidence.actual: Verifier read SOURCE_ID from source.SOURCE_ID/source.id although canonical records store SOURCE_ID in record.fields and workflow-engine recordId is the shared authority.

rows.sourceLocation: Current user task section 4C shared verifier-runtime factory requirement and section 11 fault-detection requirements
rows.observableExpectedBehavior: Every Node VM verifier consumes one shared runtime factory that supplies timers, RAF, AbortController/AbortSignal, crypto/hash prerequisites, Blob/File, URL, text codecs, and storage defaults without overwriting explicit fixture overrides. Factory-provided structuredClone returns values native to the verifier realm so production canonical hashing and plain-object checks behave the same way they do in the application.
requiredEvidence: Failing current-source reproduction of missing AbortController
Factory contract regression
Consumer scan proving no independent vm.createContext authority remains
Affected mobile-operation and downstream conformance suites
Failing run-5890 reproduction of foreign-realm structuredClone output rejected by production canonical hashing
Realm-local structuredClone contract regression and targeted host-realm fault injection

executedEvidence.actual: Capability probe failed with 'AbortController is not defined'; verifier context reported typeof AbortController === 'undefined'.

executedEvidence.case: verify-final-product-timing.mjs in Physical iPhone release-tag governance
executedEvidence.actual: Factory-provided host structuredClone returned a foreign-realm proposal scope; production hash.js correctly rejected it as a non-plain object at $.
Shared verifier runtime passed its contract; all discovered VM consumers used the factory and mobile operation observations passed. Integrated run 5891 also passed all pre-browser gates.

rows.sourceLocation: Current user task sections 3, 4A, 4C, 9C/D/E UX-013 and 10; controlling specification History destination and retained unaccepted-candidate restoration requirements

responsibleProductionCode.symbol: captureView / document input preservation / History destination controls

rows.observableExpectedBehavior: Selecting an application-History project/version is navigation state, not a workflow draft. Choosing a retained checkpoint must not capture the selector into the current view, create an intervening checkpoint that repaints the selector, or rewrite the requested restore destination. Restoring a retained unaccepted correction must reactivate its in-page replacement confirmation without accepting it.
requiredEvidence: Run-5891 actual-browser reproduction
Regression that fails when History destination controls are serialized as workflow drafts
Targeted fault injection that reclassifies History destination controls as drafts and is detected
Real-browser restore of the retained unaccepted file correction followed by cancellation/acceptance checks

executedEvidence.actual: After selecting the retained pending checkpoint and activating History restore, #replacement-confirmation was absent. The checkpoint artifact itself contained pendingMutation, proving the recovery point was retained but the actual browser navigation path did not reactivate it.
The exact defective source serialized #history-project and #history-version as workflow drafts; the invariant regression failed before the production repair.

rows.sourceLocation: Current user task sections 4B/4C, 10, 11 and 13; controlling specification actual-control operator-journey discipline
rows.observableExpectedBehavior: The browser verifier must select projects through the actual #project-picker option value corresponding to the intended visible project and verify the resulting active project before exercising stage behavior. It must not write a JOB_ID into a selector whose production values are numeric project indices.
requiredEvidence: Run-5891 raw failure and project-picker value trace
Repaired actual-browser verifier selects the intended project then derives SEARCH_ADEQUACY_REVIEW for incomplete source discovery

executedEvidence.actual: Verifier called fill(#project-picker, JOB_ID). Production option values are numeric project indices, so the value became empty and Number("") selected projects[0], causing the test to inspect a different project and report COMPLETE instead of SEARCH_ADEQUACY_REVIEW.
